BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the interbranch advisory committee; adding a new section to chapter 2.76 RCW; and repealing RCW 2.76.800 and 2.76.900.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 2.76 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) The interbranch advisory committee may set its own meeting schedule. The committee shall discuss issues of mutual concern between the branches. Examples include, but are not limited to:
(b) Initiatives related to access to justice;
(2) Staff support for the committee will be provided by the administrative office of the courts.

BillSectionHeader.P: The following acts or parts of acts are each repealed:
